pages.title: Check the Vessel
pages.text: Read the liquid ID, stage and amount in the tooltip. Match the vessel to the recipe and the fluid. Consider whether the destination is full, or already contains a different brew or warmth.

pages.title: Check the Machine
pages.text: Let an active mash finish before draining. Distill fermented, unaged brew, with a compatible outlet at the spout. An outlet already holding slurry or a different stage can block the next output.

pages.title: Coffee in the Furnace
pages.text: Use cherries for beans. Use a filled cup for heating coffee. A hot cup is already at the final warmth and cannot cook again. Use the $(l:psychedelicraft:preparations/coffee)coffee page$(/l) to check the sequence.
